Mechanical day/night (switchable IR filter); no IR illuminator
256 presets, preset accuracy +/-0.2 deg, pan 160 deg/s, tilt 120 deg/s, 360 deg continuous pan
24 privacy masks, MOTION+ video motion detection
2 alarm inputs, 1 relay output, audio line in/out

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AUTODOME_IP_4000_HD_Data_sheet_enUS_19166796555.pdf, V8 May 2016). NEZ-4212-CPCW4 = 12x 1080p30 camera in indoor in-ceiling housing, clear bubble (C = in-ceiling; P = pendant). Sensitivity: colour 0.17 lux / mono 0.039 lux at 30 IRE, SensUp off. Power 12 W on 24 VAC or PoE+. The pendant models NEZ-4212-PPCW4 / NEZ-4112-PPCW4 are in autodome-ip-4000-hd.json. Status discontinued follows that family record; the datasheet itself does not state it.
